name: GlExtra_AlphaGraph
description: Display the outer surface defined by alpha contour. Add it to qt.Renderer().extraDrawers. If no instance of TesselationWrapper is provided, the functor will create its own. See :ysrc:`scripts/examples/alphaShapes/GlDrawAlpha.py`.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: radius of cylinder representation, if null 1/12th of average diameter will be used

attributes.name: wire
attributes.description: display as solid cylinders or lines

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refresh internals. Particularly usefull for correct display after the TesselationWrapper is modified externally, not needed if 'wire'=True
